Note Regex Accessor API Reference¶

Back to Note API Reference

Note::regex() is the pattern-processing boundary for Note. The family has six canonical operations, each answering a different question about the same ECMAScript regular-expression language.

Need

Method

Result

Count non-overlapping matches per cell

count

Shape-preserving Int64 Note

Extract every non-overlapping match

findall

TokenBatch

Validate the complete contents of each cell

match

Shape-preserving Bool Note

Rewrite every non-overlapping match

replace

Shape-preserving Text Note

Test whether any substring matches

search

Shape-preserving Bool Note

Cut each cell at matching delimiters

split

TokenBatch

findall() and split() are not aliases. The first returns the spans that match; the second returns the text between matching spans. Likewise, match() requires the pattern to cover a complete cell, while search() only requires one occurrence. These distinctions are why the family has separate methods rather than one mode-heavy call.

The accessor deliberately has no tokens() synonym for findall(). Language tokenization belongs to Note::nlp(), literal field splitting belongs to Note::split(), and pattern-defined extraction belongs here.
